_about: Gold for the evidence repeat / replace / new decisions of the seed (20 NVDA items, 2026-02-25..07-23), labelled by Claude on 2026-10-25 from the texts under 06-views.md's definitions: repeat = the same evidence already exists under the thesis (a retelling, the same number in text and table, the same speaker repeating the same statement); replace = a later account of the same matter (a speaker revises guidance, a forecast or event progress; an official confirms or denies; the original source revises its statement); otherwise new. Alex (2026-10-25): '你的 golden 是什么，你得看下 jev 是不是其实是判对的' — before this file the only reference was the stored pipeline's own decision. A key is '<input short name>|<handover evidence id>|<view id>' as both arms' match records carry it. 'targets' are substrings of the one-line of any stored piece that is an acceptable target (ids differ between ledgers); 'uncertain' marks a case where two readings are defensible: not scored.
